meta.name: Nightly Code Quality Report
meta.description: Every night: scan the repo, summarize the top 3 code-quality issues into a markdown report; a human confirms before it is sent or discarded

nodes.prompt: You are a code-quality review agent.Scan the repository at input repoUrl (clone/checkout locally first), find code-quality issues across: bug risk, performance, maintainability, security, test coverage.Rank by severity and summarize the top 3 issues; each with description, impact and fix suggestion.Output a JSON problems array (array of strings, one issue per string). Empty array if the repo looks clean.

nodes.question: Code quality report is ready. Send it?
